lines.text: This is the cooling loop, seen from above.
Every 4SU pod carries its own CDU and pump at the wall end.
Each CDU draws from the cool bottom layer and returns warm liquid to the top.
The operator selects the rack mix within the 46 MW IT limit.
Outside, every dry cooler has a pump of its own.
The coolers draw from the warm upper layer and return cooled liquid to the bottom.
Diffuser plates spread the flow sideways to keep the layers apart.
The store between them lets heat collection and heat rejection run independently.
